desc: Write `solve()` that reads N, M, A, builds adjacency, finds cycles via DFS state (0/1/2) and records cycle nodes, and builds `children` for non-cycle nodes.
For each tree node, compute `f[u][v]` for v=1..M using bottom-up DP and prefix products.
For each weakly connected component, compute contribution = Σ_{v=1}^{M} Π_{trees T} f_T(v) and multiply all contributions mod 998244353.
Test on the three provided samples to verify outputs 6, 2025, 10010.
